steps.title: Define Brand Palette, Color Tokens, and Material Styles
steps.description: Configure emerald jewel brand colors, background neutrals, metric container strokes, and button styling in colors.xml, styles.xml, and strings.xml.

steps.title: Create Dynamic Surface Backgrounds and Status Badges
steps.description: Design gradient header shapes, white elevated cards, input field selectors, pill status indicators, and custom button drawables.

steps.title: Implement Data Models and SQLite Persistence Architecture
steps.description: Define object schemas for Product, Customer, SaleItem, Purchase, and Expense, and construct SQLite helper with automated schema initialization.

steps.title: Construct POS Central Dashboard and Store Metrics Overview
steps.description: Build MainActivity layout and class providing instant launch button for new billing, live financial counters, stock alerts, and feature grid.

steps.title: Develop Product Inventory Management and Real-time Search
steps.description: Implement ProductListActivity and AddEditProductActivity with real-time text query filtering, low-stock visual badges, and stock edit form.

steps.title: Build Customer Udhaar Registry and Onboarding Workflows
steps.description: Create customer directory view and registration screen to track customer names, mobile numbers, and running credit balances.

steps.title: Construct Customer Ledger Timeline and Payment Settlement
steps.description: Engineer detailed customer credit history activity showcasing transaction timeline, credit purchases, and cash repayment entries.

steps.title: Engineer Point-of-Sale Checkout Terminal and Cart System
steps.description: Implement interactive checkout layout and controller with dynamic item selection, live quantity multipliers, discounts, and payment mode selector.

steps.title: Design Clean Printable Sale Receipt and Bill Summary
steps.description: Build sale invoice detail view presenting itemized items, subtotal calculations, applied discounts, customer info, and final paid total.

steps.title: Implement Stock Inward Inflow Procurement Module
steps.description: Build purchase registry list and inward inventory intake screen to update store product stock quantities and record supplier costs.

steps.title: Develop Operational Expense Tracker and Overhead Logger
steps.description: Construct store expense entry interface and listing view categorized by utility bills, shop rent, wages, and daily operational overheads.

steps.title: Implement Store Profit Margin Analytics and Data Backup
steps.description: Calculate overall store revenues, gross stock expenditures, operating overheads, net store margins, and generate CSV data backups.

steps.title: Building Al Faris Kirana
steps.description: Compile layout resources, validate SQLite schemas, link activity navigation routes, and build final release APK package.
